places-masada-old-city-of-jerusalem-and-.story: 336 km from Arad to Arad, about 5 h 48 of riding. It goes by way of Hebron/Al-Khalil Old Town, Old City of Jerusalem and its Walls, back through Hebron/Al-Khalil Old Town and back through Old City of Jerusalem and its Walls. It crosses from Israel into Palestinian Territories - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
